# Invitations and requests API endpoints
{: .no_toc}

Membership is managed through invitations and requests: an invitation offers a user or a group a role on a project, a group or a personal attribute, a request asks to join a group, and a pending invitation holds an invitation for an email address that has no account yet.

| Resource | App | What it is |
|:---------|:----|:-----------|
| [`projectgroupmembershipinvitation`](/api/stem/projectgroupmembershipinvitation/) | STEM | Table to store invitations for groups to join a project |
| [`projectmembershipinvitation`](/api/stem/projectmembershipinvitation/) | STEM | Table to store invitations for members to join a project |
| [`behavioralassaygroupmembershipinvitation`](/api/personal_attributes/behavioralassaygroupmembershipinvitation/) | Personal Attributes | Table to store invitations for groups to join a behavioral assay |
| [`behavioralassaymembershipinvitation`](/api/personal_attributes/behavioralassaymembershipinvitation/) | Personal Attributes | Table to store invitations for members to join a behavioral assay |
| [`datastoragegroupmembershipinvitation`](/api/personal_attributes/datastoragegroupmembershipinvitation/) | Personal Attributes | Table to store invitations for groups to join a data storage |
| [`datastoragemembershipinvitation`](/api/personal_attributes/datastoragemembershipinvitation/) | Personal Attributes | Table to store invitations for members to join a data storage |
| [`inventorygroupmembershipinvitation`](/api/personal_attributes/inventorygroupmembershipinvitation/) | Personal Attributes | Table to store invitations for groups to join an inventory |
| [`inventorymembershipinvitation`](/api/personal_attributes/inventorymembershipinvitation/) | Personal Attributes | Table to store invitations for members to join an inventory |
| [`licensegroupmembershipinvitation`](/api/personal_attributes/licensegroupmembershipinvitation/) | Personal Attributes | Table to store invitations for groups to join a license |
| [`licensemembershipinvitation`](/api/personal_attributes/licensemembershipinvitation/) | Personal Attributes | Table to store invitations for members to join a license |
| [`protocolgroupmembershipinvitation`](/api/personal_attributes/protocolgroupmembershipinvitation/) | Personal Attributes | Protocol group membership invitation records |
| [`protocolmembershipinvitation`](/api/personal_attributes/protocolmembershipinvitation/) | Personal Attributes | Protocol membership invitation records |
| [`setupgroupmembershipinvitation`](/api/personal_attributes/setupgroupmembershipinvitation/) | Personal Attributes | Table to store invitations for groups to join a data storage |
| [`setupmembershipinvitation`](/api/personal_attributes/setupmembershipinvitation/) | Personal Attributes | Table to store invitations for members to join a data storage |
| [`groupmembershipinvitation`](/api/users/groupmembershipinvitation/) | Users | Group membership invitation records |
| [`groupmembershiprequest`](/api/users/groupmembershiprequest/) | Users | Group membership request records |
| [`pendinginvitation`](/api/users/pendinginvitation/) | Users | An invitation by email to someone without an account yet, for a role on a group, project or personal attribute; it takes effect when they sign up |
